meaning: ST I q.11 a.3 co., second proof, for the prima via's mover: distinct first movers would differ in some act, contradicting the open bridge that each has every perfection; with excluded middle for their identity, there is at most one. The Comparator config also verifies premisesJointlySatisfiable: the prima via premises and all premises of the #165 results hold in one finite model that also witnesses a per se link, a moving body, a composite with a component, matter-form composition and an esse other than an essence. The plural-difference premise holds there only vacuously, as it must in any model of all the premises.
